summary: This flow diagram titled 'Identification through database search' outlines the process of identifying records for a study. It begins with 730 records identified through database search with queries and a recency filter. After removing duplicates, the total remains 730. All records are screened, resulting in 616 records excluded. Subsequently, 114 full-text articles are assessed for eligibility, leading to 50 articles excluded for being irrelevant to the definition of an AI agent. Ultimately, 64 studies are included in the review. The diagram visually represents the steps and decisions made throughout the identification process.
